item.title: BitMart Founder Denies Asset Misappropriation Amid Orderly Exchange Wind-Down
item.summary: BitMart's founder denied asset misappropriation and confirmed the exchange is conducting an orderly wind-down, with trading set to halt August 26 and full cessation by January 31, 2027; on-chain data cited by Cointelegraph showed approximately $69–71 million in tracked wallets.
